row:
Serving the public interest, Kentucky Educational Television (KET) enriches lives and builds stronger communities by educating, informing, inspiring, and connecting people of every age and circumstance through the power of public media.

We're an innovative and efficient producer of digital education tools for the classroom and Kentucky’s highest-quality source for public affairs and cultural programming. We work each day to help people everywhere continue to learn throughout their lives.

KET relies on financial support from viewers like you!

Contributions from people like you allow us to deliver content from PBS and other sources to more than 7 million people across Kentucky and the surrounding states. Your generosity also helps KET advance as Kentucky’s largest classroom, town hall, concert stage, history and science center, and so much more.
